data.name: Maimana
data.gender_notes: Maimana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'maimana', which means 'support', 'aid', or 'assistance'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the idea of providing comfort, care, and strength to others. The name Maimana carries the meaning “Support, Aid, Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maimana usually hope their child will grow to embody support, aid, assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maimana carries a rich cultural heritage, originating from the Persian language of Iran. Historically, this name has been associated with kings and rulers who prided themselves on their ability to provide help and support to their people. The name also holds strong connections to Sufism, the mystical and spiritual branch of Islam, with many Sufi scholars and saints possessing this name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Maimana evokes the idea of being a source of comfort and strength for others. It is a reminder of the importance of selflessness, compassion, and love in helping those in need. This name is particularly significant during times of hardship, offering hope and inspiration for those seeking support, guidance, or relief. In this way, Maimana embodies the holistic Islamic teachings of kindness, empathy, and community care.
